$comment: Authoritative layout tokens for paper-sharing-ppt decks. SKILL.md states the rules; this file is the machine-readable copy used when writing the build script. scripts/check_deck.py enforces the same numbers by default.

margins.$comment: body_cm applies to left/right/bottom and to the top unless the text hangs in the label band clear of the label; chrome_cm covers the section label and page number.

section_label.corner_rule: one corner per section, identical offset and size across the slides of that section; left corner for left-aligned corners, right-aligned text in the right corner

fonts.$comment: Every run carries <a:latin>, <a:ea> and <a:cs>; PowerPoint resolves each character against the matching slot, so mixed Chinese/English runs need no splitting.

palette.$comment: Black text on white. Muted grey is reserved for chrome. The accent may be used only to mark best-result cells in a recreated table, together with bold; no other colour is allowed.

slides.$comment: At 18 pt with a 1.2 cm inset a full-width slide holds about 45 Chinese characters per line and 15 lines; plan 350-450 characters of readable prose per slide.

images.$comment: Place with width only and centre with left = (canvas_width - width) / 2. Crop with scripts/crop_pdf.py, which pads all four sides equally.

gates.render_check: render every slide and inspect before delivery; re-check at most twice per slide, then change the layout
